vo.en: Pick a number between five and twelve.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's face looking directly at the camera with intense concentration.

vo.en: Got it? Good. Multiply it by two, and add fourteen to that result.

visual.description: Rapidly shifting digital neon numbers flashing across a dark background.

vo.en: Now quickly divide that number by two, then subtract your original starting number.

visual.description: A man's hands writing complex mathematical equations on a dusty chalkboard quickly.

vo.en: Wait, here is the creepy part: I already know your answer.

visual.description: A macro close-up of a human eye iris dilating rapidly with a digital glitch overlay.

vo.en: Your result is the number seven.

visual.description: A dart flying through the air in slow motion and hitting the exact center of a bullseye.

vo.en: It’s not a glitch; it’s a mathematical certainty disguised as a mental illusion.

visual.description: Detailed mechanical gears turning perfectly in sync inside a watch or engine.

vo.en: The algebra forces the answer to seven every time, regardless of the number you started with.

visual.description: A man's hand moving a chess piece strategically on a dark wooden board.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if this worked on you... which is exactly why
